# Contributing

Please check out common DSC Community [contributing guidelines](https://dsccommunity.org/guidelines/contributing).

## Running the Tests

Run `./build.ps1` to build and verify changes locally. See [BUILDING.md](../BUILDING.md) for test suites, dependencies and release conventions.

Use Conventional Commit messages and squash-merge PR titles, such as `fix: handle an empty response` or `chore: update dependencies`. Release Please generates the changelog and releases from releasable commits; do not edit the changelog by hand for routine changes.
